text: You are angry about the quality of the two skateboards you just bought. You want to return them and refund to credit card.  If the agent asks for confirmation, do not say yes immediately, because you also want to return the smart watch and e-reader.
zh: 你對剛剛買的兩個滑板質量很生氣。你想退貨並退款到信用卡。如果客服要求確認，不要馬上說是，因為你還想退回智能手錶和電子閱讀器。(滑板 #W1234567)
